module: Module 2: MAM Allocation Methods & Sizing Engine
title: Minimum Lot Size Enforcement (0.01 Floor)
precondition: Micro-account with $100 balance in $1,000,000 group; proportional calculation yields 0.001 lots.
steps: 1. Process order sizing under 0.01 minimum lot policy.
expected_result: Sizing engine drops order (does not execute) or clamps to 0.01 based on configured policy; zero 0.000 lot rejected orders.
actual_result: Sizing engine clamps or suppresses micro-orders below 0.01 floor to prevent broker order rejection.
